email.subject: Proposal and five-slide kickoff deck for Maple & Moss
email.bodyText: Please prepare a proposal DOCX and a five-slide kickoff PPTX using the attached brief and Harbor Creative's standard package. Please have the review draft ready by Monday, October 26, 2026 at 9:00 AM Pacific, before our client discussion. The engagement would start October 26 and run for four weeks.
